name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audits any website for the reasons AI assistants fail to find, trust and cite it, and the reasons visitors who do arrive fail to engage. Emits one evidence-backed report of findings plus prioritized, mechanism-sound fixes. Recommend-only: never modifies the audited site.

skills.summary: Receives the audit request, profiles the site, dispatches every analysis skill over one shared evidence bundle, merges and de-duplicates their findings, applies the severity and false-positive rules, and emits the final report.
The only skill that touches the network. Performs one polite, robots-respecting, budget-bounded crawl and writes a normalized evidence bundle to disk for every other skill to analyze.
Can a machine get in at all? robots.txt per AI user-agent, CDN bot-blocking, sitemaps, indexability directives, canonicals, redirects, reachability.
Can a machine read what is there? JS-dependent content, facts locked in images or PDFs, content behind interaction or consent walls, semantic structure.
Can a machine parse specific facts out? schema.org coverage and validity, required properties by type, entity graph, and markup that contradicts the visible page.
Can a machine lift a clear, self-contained fact? Chunk-level retrieval simulation, explicit identity and key-fact statements, and coverage of the questions buyers actually ask.
Will a machine believe and repeat the fact? Content recency and date honesty, off-site corroboration of key claims, brand entity ambiguity, and identity anchors.
Does the visitor who arrives stay? Above-the-fold orientation, AI-referral landing continuity, context retention, friction, interstitials, and performance proxies.

$comment: status is build-tracking metadata for this team, not part of the contest convention: 'complete' skills are implemented and tested; 'scaffold' skills have a frozen SKILL.md and check registry with the check script still to be written. tools/validate.py reports a scaffold skill's missing scripts as TODO rather than as a spec violation. Every skill is agentskills.io-valid either way.
